## Who We Are

Harmony Healthcare IT delivers technology solutions that protect health information, enhance productivity, and optimize cash flow for healthcare organizations. We are best known for our data extraction, migration, and retention work, ensuring system reliability and data integrity 24/7.

[Learn More](https://www.harmonyhit.com/get-to-know-us/)

87% of employees at Harmony Healthcare IT say it is a great place to work compared to 59% of employees at a typical US-based company.

Source: [Great Place to Work® U.S. National Employee Engagement Study.](https://www.greatplacetowork.com/certified-company/7027229)
